title: Princess Y72
description:
This 2021 Princess Y72 pairs sporty performance with a refined interior in silver oak, with walnut planked floors in the galley, dinette and helm. Twin MAN V12-1650 engines with 1,182 hours give 32 knots cruising and 35 knots top speed.

Options include a dual-station joystick and an Idromar 160 L/h watermaker. Four cabins. She is lying in Imperia, Italy.
